_doc: Named asset passes. A pass is one deliberate change to the shipped modular art. inventory.py groups git commits into passes by the commit prefixes listed here (a commit in no pass joins the last pass in the list) and stamps every asset with the pass that last changed it. 'current' is the pass the working tree represents; edit it, and add the new pass below, when a new pass lands. The label (v5, v6, ...) is the stable name; the commit hash is the identity.
